name: Beach Front Rustic Cabin
description:
Watch a beautiful sun sets over the Trout River or take a stroll on a sandy beach  all from your  Beach Front cabin.  
Our  Beach front camp cabins are a basic wooded structure which will accommodate a family of three (3) with bunk beds single on top and a futon (double on bottom). Each cabin includes a small table, two (2) chairs, one (1) electrical outlet, Coffee maker, small Refrigerator,  ceiling light, outdoor light, smoke detector, and fire extinguisher. Camp Cabins are situated on individual semi-private, wooded sites. Shared water source is provided.
